sys_script_fix.description: v0.6 (O02): links every observation to its tracked object, creating missing objects. Idempotent; runs on install/upgrade.
sys_script_fix.name: Driftwood - Backfill tracked objects
sys_script_fix.script: /* Driftwood - Backfill tracked objects (v0.6, O02) * Links every stored observation (tracked items, tracked CIs) to its tracked * object, creating the objects that don't exist yet. Inherited columns (Z12) * get no object. Idempotent: it only creates objects and fills empty Object * references, so it is safe to re-run. Runs automatically when Driftwood is * installed or upgraded from the application repository. * * Dry run first: Scripts - Background, script scope Driftwood: * gs.info(new ConfigNowObjects().backfill({ dryRun: true }).text); */ gs.info(new ConfigNowObjects().backfill({ dryRun: false }).text);
